verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a webhook doc listing "a comment has been added" as a Penpot event, which implies files support comments. Nothing describes how commenting works on designs, and @mentions and resolving threads are not covered at all. missing for 10: first-party docs on commenting directly on canvas/designs, @mentioning teammates, resolving comment threads, independent or hands-on corroboration of in-file review workflows.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can comment directly on designs, mention teammates, and resolve threads so review happens in the file, not in email
